client_channel_unsupported.description: The Runtime closed the connection on BindChannel without a receipt: an actingd built before #389 U-2. The client reconnected once, checked the owner epoch and goes on without a channel; it sends no BindChannel on later reconnects. Reported once per client process, on stderr or in the MCP warnings.
client_channel_unsupported.common_causes: Root Tools newer than the actingd of the selected slot, for example after a slot rollback.
client_channel_unsupported.handling: Nothing to repair. Each such client process leaves one connection failure in that actingd's ledger; Tools and Runtime of one release bind their channels.

client_channel_refused.description: From #389 U-6 on, the runtime client's own check for a Lab-only session (resource authoring, runtime debug) refused a client whose channel is not lab; channel names the client's channel.
client_channel_refused.common_causes: A program other than actinglab opened a Lab session through the runtime client library.
